heartbeat_interval.description: Interval in seconds between heartbeat signals. Set to 0 to disable.

workers.description: Number of worker threads for event processing. Use 0 for auto-detection.

ctable_size.description: Maximum number of connection tracking entries to cache in memory.

sync_mode.description: Synchronization mode: 'firewall' for HA with failover, 'standard' for passive sync, 'userspace' for advanced use.

sync_interface.description: Network interface used for sync traffic (required for unicast/multicast).

sync_bind_address.description: Local IP address to bind for sync traffic. Defaults to all interfaces.

sync_port.description: Port to use for TCP/UDP sync communication.

sync_multicast_group.description: Multicast IP address for broadcast/multicast sync (e.g., 225.0.0.50).

port.description: Port on sibling node (defaults to global sync port).

sync_siblings.description: List of peer nodes for unicast synchronization. Format: [{ip: '10.0.0.2'}, ...].

sync_flush_on_timeout.description: Whether to flush local connection tracking table on sync timeout.

sync_heartbeat_enabled.description: Enable/disable heartbeat messages in sync protocol.

log_target.description: Path to log file (or 'syslog' to use system logging).

event_filters.description: List of filters to exclude specific events from synchronization.

cache_tables.description: Custom timeout values for connection tracking entries (keys: tcp, udp, icmp, other).

nl_socket_buf_maxsize.description: Netlink socket receive buffer maximum size (bytes).

external_cache_enabled.description: Enable external cache for advanced use cases (e.g., with LVS).

failover_mechanism.description: HA mode: 'active' (primary node syncs and accepts new connections), 'backup' (passive), or 'none' (disabled).

ha_node_id.description: Unique node identifier for HA cluster (1–255).

ha_secret.description: Shared secret for authentication in HA mode (must be identical on all nodes).
